notes.title: ⚗️New Hero: The Alchemist Joins the Game!
notes.content:
Magic isn't just about casting spells — sometimes, it's about mixing the right ingredients. Meet our newest hero: The Alchemist, a master of craft and transformation!

 What makes the Alchemist unique?

- Brews twice as many potions as any ordinary wizard.

- Crafted cards are always of a higher rank.

And with enough crafted cards in hand, they can even boost the rank of a card in the pyramid!

New enchantments like The Power of Crystals and Magnum Opus open up entirely new ways to approach crafting strategies. Will you unlock their full potential?

It’s time to play with crystals ✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416872/dbeecdb5c524e301eac7ae90eeffcbc903ae9759.png[/img]

notes.title: A new heroine: Elementalist!
notes.content:
We added a new heroine!
🔥 Meet the Elementalist! 🔥

She listens to the Elemental Winds, weaving their ever-changing power into spectacular combos. But beware—losing track of the wind’s will can shatter even the best-laid plans!

Harness the shifting Elemental Winds with her unique abilities:
🌪️ Elemental Wind (Passive):
The Focus Element changes with every Draw.
✅ Combinations using only the Focus Element gain +1 Mul.
❌ Combinations with no matching element suffer -1 Mul.

🔄 Elemental Shift (Active):
Choose a card in the pyramid—all cards of the same element transform into a new element. Then, the Focus Element shifts. Use once per Draw.

Master the winds, adapt to their flow, and turn chaos into power! 🌪️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416872/1512b1807d85adc7a89e6020571cec0aa7262f7f.png[/img]

notes.title: Gameplay Tweaks: Smoother Start & Clearer Scoring!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We're thrilled to see so many of you playing our game and sharing your thoughts—thank you for your feedback! Thanks to your valuable comments, we've made some improvements:

- Reduced the difficulty of the first few levels
- Сombination "Same Strength" now gives bonus 20×2 points—hopefully, it's now clearer which moves are the most rewarding
- Tweaked some amulet bonuses for better balance

We’re constantly working to improve the player experience, and we hope you’ll give our game another try!

notes.title: Demo Out Now!!
notes.content:
You can finally check out our card roguelike deckbuilder! Join us at our magical table filled with cards, artifacts, and mystical crystals. Build clever combos, use spells, transform cards, and take your time—there’s no rush!

The Wizard Hand Demo showcases the game's core mechanics, including:

🔮 Over 20 Artifacts that multiply points and have a lot of useful effects
✨15+ Crystals – Contain crafting recipes to temporarily transform cards
👁️ Pyramid Guardians – Mysterious entities that use their power to stop you
🃏 Enchanted Cards – Build your own magical deck and use cards in unexpected ways
⚔️ Bosses – Unique challenges that force you to rethink your strategy
🔼 Card Upgrades – Every card in your deck can be made stronger
🔥 Streak Mechanic – Chain combinations to stack even greater result

The full game expands on this foundation with a vast array of artifacts and crafting recipes that unlock between runs, ensuring each new attempt feels fresh. It will also introduce playable characters, each with unique abilities, along with even more enchanted cards and formidable bosses to challenge your mastery of magical solitaire.

Play now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3535910/Wizard_Hand_Demo/

Love the demo?! Don't forget to leave a positive review and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3444830/Wizard_Hand/]wishlist the full game[/url]—it helps a ton!

Have fun!

With love, Capibarium

notes.title: Wizard Hand is participating in the Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce that our game is officially registered for Steam Next Fest! 🎉 While the demo isn’t quite ready yet, it’s currently in the oven, baking to perfection. ✨
Our goal is to showcase the gameplay experience you can expect in the final version of the game. Stay tuned for more updates on the demo and the game's development process.
Follow us to be the first to know when the demo drops!
